integrity: The all-spider formula is proved from unique geodesics; an independent graph-level subset checker corroborates it on bounded orders, and an exact partition enumeration proves the finite spider cutoff.
scientific_limitations: The minimum-order classification is among spider trees, not among all trees.
The direct definition-level exhaustive graph check is bounded to spider orders at most eleven.
The order-twenty-two cutoff uses the proved closed formula plus exhaustive enumeration of integer partitions.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed prior work.
title: General position polynomials of spiders and the smallest nonunimodal spider
